views.createSql:
CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT providerId,
               externalId,
               dayStartMs AS date,
               MAX(played) AS played,
               MAX(skipped) AS skipped,
               SUM(durationMs) AS durationMs,
               COUNT(*) AS playCount
        FROM play_events
        GROUP BY providerId, externalId, dayStartMs
